batch.sort_option: 完整快照｜不受UI篩選影響

chart_semantics.real_daily_candle: ordinary daily OHLC aligned 1:1 with each HA/BB point; used for structural 1.236 invalidation

visual_summary.note: raw chart_30d remains authoritative; summary labels are mechanical aids for AI

long_opportunity.scope: fast long-side opportunity scanner; it intentionally ignores structures outside S0/S0.5/S1/S2/S3
long_opportunity.priority: S3 > S0.5 > S2 > S1 > S0 > OTHER (S1/S2 are both 3 stars; S2 sorts first as later progress)
long_opportunity.S0: below midline: fresh yellow break above Purple-2 after a mainly one-way purple liquidation leg; bounce only
long_opportunity.S0.5: below midline: fresh yellow break above Purple-2 with either friendly midline OR a visible second-leg base (Higher-Low/W/Cup/double-bottom) inside the 30d window
long_opportunity.S1: yellow run originated from below midline, beat its state-scoped Purple-2 and crossed above midline; remains S1 while still in the early midline-to-upper-band zone, regardless of yellow day count
long_opportunity.S2: wave-2 waiting state after a visible first-wave push; live purple must enter the actionable upper-midline zone. Failed small yellow bounces do not erase S2 memory; Purple-2 is frozen only after a completed purple run turns yellow
long_opportunity.S3: S2 pullback finished, turned yellow and beat the completed pullback Purple-2; stays S3 only while BB band-position still leaves entry room, not by a fixed day count
long_opportunity.midline_regime: rising / flat / flattening / falling from recent 5d midline slope
long_opportunity.near_midline: adaptive BB band-position geometry, not a fixed price percentage
long_opportunity.dynamic_purple2: Dynamic L/R/Fib Purple-2 is now scoped mainly to below-midline S0/S0.5. S2 does not guess P2 while purple is still open; S3 freezes the finished S2 purple run and uses the purple immediately before that run's lowest purple.
long_opportunity.one_star_note: one star is not failure; it can mean mature expansion / do-not-chase or otherwise poor long entry timing
